This last AUDUSD engulf example is confusing me a lot recently showing me gaps in understanding the engulf... Sorry to go a bit off from the original topic (quasimodo).

Was it really an engulf? No significant FL was broken here AU 30m

AU 5m zoomed in

Maybe the correct version is: those boxes are actual flag limits whereas the RBD is a failed to return (failed attempt)to get back above the single bar FL? But then, the question is, does an engulf have to break a true FL or just a FTR (reacton to FL)? OMG a simple yes/no would help me a lot.

Regarding the AU question, forexlit, I think it reached the target, still not the deepest possible one.

posts.t: Hi Forexlit, This could be the answer you are looking for. This is a reverse Diamond formation, which is a Bullish Pattern, The price wanted to complete the diamond formation, so it went up touched the flag Limit (C) taking out all the pending sell orders there, then came down sharply breaking the demand (1) to attract novice seller's or Breakout seller's and from diamond demand flag Limit (Swap) (2), it went up sharply, changing the trend to up. So what you thought was a Quasimodo is actually a trap laid down by the institutions. And hence your target was not achieved and price hit your stop loss.
posts.fa: سلام Forexlit، این می‌تواند همان جوابی باشد که دنبالش هستی. این یک الگوی الماس معکوس است، یک الگوی صعودی؛ قیمت می‌خواست الگوی الماس را کامل کند، پس بالا رفت، FL (C) را لمس کرد و همهٔ سفارش‌های فروش معلق آنجا را شکار کرد، بعد تند پایین آمد و تقاضا را شکست تا فروشندگان تازه‌کار یا فروشندگان بروک‌اوت را جذب کند و از FL سواپِ تقاضای الماس تند بالا رفت و روند را به بالا تغییر داد. پس چیزی که فکر می‌کردی QM است در واقع تله‌ای است که مؤسسات پهن کرده‌اند. و به همین دلیل تارگتت محقق نشد و قیمت حد ضرر تو را خورد. 1 2

All good comments

However, look for horizontal symmetry rather than diagonal. It's far simpler than you can imagine.

Put all my videos together into one, and you'll see what I mean.

All the pieces are there, but you'll find that some pieces from one video fit perfectly into empty spaces in another.

So juxtapose the information and you'll get a more complete picture.

You all know why I can't just tell you it all explicitly.

Believe me, I could have a very rich lifestyle if I were to open the academy at €100 per month per student. I'd easily get €100,000 per month, and get to expose the scam of the markets in the process.

Win win? No. I'd end up needing to continually decode the new tricks they'd be forced to invent, and you'd all end up bewildered and lost.

Those of you who are meant to get this WILL get this, without my going into further detail.

There was a quasimodo on GBP/USD:

It was formed on a very good place (Supply/FL). However price did not react to QM level, rather it reacted to this FL. So, if you took a trade you should put your SL above the FL, not above the QM high.
